node.title: Rate-half MCA two-anchor reserve repricing
node.statement: On the deployed KoalaBear and Mersenne-31 MCA adjacent rows, placing the proved near-rational first-match owner of size at most 2w before the residual 31-slope exception set changes the active large-owner target exactly from B*-31-(n-g) to B*-(2w+31)-(n-g). The revised conditional assembly sums exactly to B* in the large-owner case and retains positive margins in every smaller-owner and affine case. The revised full-owner targets are 274980728111260112 and 16642288, still at least 4807520 and 9 times the proved exact average ceilings. This proves arithmetic viability and exact repricing only; the stricter large-owner theorem and all S/A/E premises remain open.
